name: uxr-desk-research
description: Builds a Desk Research Summary of what is already known about users, with source and date per finding, what is stale, the open questions left and what not to research again. Use for "run uxr-desk-research", "what do we already know", "summarise past research", "read last year's research", "pull together prior findings", "has anyone studied this before", "desk research before the study", "secondary research summary", part of the UX Research with Claude Pack by 90n.
